# Configuration reference

*Generated by `python3 dev/gen-config-docs.py` from the JSON schemas in
`package-content/`. Edit the schema, not this file.*

Foton writes its defaults on first boot into `config/` next to the server
binary, then reads them on every later start. Each file carries a `#:schema`
line so an editor with TOML schema support can complete and validate it.

## `config.toml` — Server

Configuration schema for Foton Minecraft server.

### `[server]`

Server configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server_port` *(required)* | integer | `25565` | 1–65000 | Server port |
| `max_players` *(required)* | integer | `20` | 1–2147483647 | Maximum number of players allowed on the server |
| `allow_extended_view_distance` | boolean | `false` |  | Allow view_distance above vanilla's 32-chunk cap, up to Foton's 128-chunk cap |
| `view_distance` *(required)* | integer | `10` | 1–128 | Maximum view distance in chunks. Normally 1-32; 1-128 when allow_extended_view_distance is true. |
| `simulation_distance` *(required)* | integer | `10` | 1–128 | Maximum simulation distance in chunks |
| `max_chained_neighbor_updates` | integer | `1000000` |  | Maximum queued neighbor-update tasks in one chained run. Negative values disable the limit. |
| `online_mode` *(required)* | boolean | `true` |  | Whether to use Mojang's authentication service |
| `auth_server` | string |  | uri | Optional authentication endpoint for online-mode hasJoined checks. Omit to use Mojang's session server. |
| `profile_server` | string |  | uri | Optional endpoint for online-mode player name-to-profile lookups. Omit to use Mojang's profile service. |
| `services_server` | string |  | uri | Optional endpoint for Mojang-compatible service public keys. Omit to use Mojang's services endpoint. |
| `encryption` *(required)* | boolean | `true` |  | Whether to enable encryption for client-server communication. Required in online mode. |
| `allow_flight` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the server allows unauthorized client flight |
| `motd` *(required)* | string | `"A Foton Server"` |  | Message of the day displayed in server lists |
| `use_favicon` *(required)* | boolean | `true` |  | Whether to use a custom favicon for the server |
| `favicon` *(required)* | string | `"config/favicon.png"` |  | Path to the favicon file (PNG format, 64x64 pixels) |
| `enforce_secure_chat` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether to enforce secure chat |
| `chat_spam_threshold_seconds` | integer | `10` |  | Vanilla chat spam threshold window in seconds; values <= 0 disable throttling |
| `command_spam_threshold_seconds` | integer | `10` |  | Vanilla command spam threshold window in seconds; values <= 0 disable throttling |

#### `[server.compression]`

Compression settings

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `threshold` *(required)* | integer | `256` | 256–2147483647 | Compression threshold in bytes |
| `level` *(required)* | integer | `4` | 1–9 | Compression level (1 = fastest, 9 = best compression) |

#### `[server.server_links]`

Server links configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | boolean | `false` |  | Enable the server links feature |
| `links` | array of table | `[]` |  | List of server links to display in the server menu |

#### `[server.rcon]`

Remote administration over the Source Rcon protocol

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the rcon port is opened at all |
| `port` | integer | `25575` | 1–65535 | Port rcon listens on |
| `password` | string | `""` |  | Password every rcon client must send before it may run a command |

#### `[server.threads]`

Optional worker counts for server thread pools. 0 or omitted uses each pool's automatic default.

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `main_runtime` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | Worker threads for the primary Tokio runtime |
| `chunk_runtime` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | Worker threads for the chunk Tokio runtime |
| `packet_workers` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | Persistent workers for inter-tick gameplay packet processing |
| `chunk_generation` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | Worker threads for the Rayon chunk generation pool |
| `chunk_encoding` | integer | `0` | ≥ 0 | Worker threads for the Rayon chunk encoding pool |

### `[log]`

Logging configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `log_path` | string | `"./.logs"` |  | Path where store the log files and history |
| `log_level` | `error` \| `warn` \| `info` \| `debug` \| `trace` | `"info"` |  | The level of information the logger will show |
| `time` | `none` \| `date` \| `uptime` | `"uptime"` |  | Time format: none, date (HH:MM:SS:mmm), or uptime (seconds since start) |
| `module_path` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the module_path of the log should be displayed |
| `extra` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the extra data of the log should be displayed |
| `log_file` | boolean | `true` |  | Whether the log should be written into a file |
| `rotation_time` | `none` \| `hourly` \| `daily` \| `weekly` \| `monthly` | `"daily"` |  | Time between log file rotations |
| `max_history` | integer | `50` | ≥ 1 | Amount of console commands saved |

## `worlds.toml` — Worlds

World and domain configuration schema for Foton.

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `save_path` | string | `"saves"` |  | Root directory for saves |
| `seed` | string | `""` |  | Root seed default; empty means random |
| `default_gamemode` | [`gamemode`](#gamemode) | `"survival"` |  |  |
| `difficulty` | [`difficulty`](#difficulty) | `"normal"` |  |  |
| `storage` | [`storage`](#storage) |  |  |  |
| `player_storage` | [`player_storage`](#player-storage) |  |  |  |
| `domains` *(required)* | table |  |  | Domain declarations keyed by domain name |

### Shapes used by `worlds.toml`

#### `storage`

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` *(required)* | `foton:disk` \| `foton:ram` |  |  |  |
| `config` | table |  |  | Storage-specific config. foton:disk supports optional relative path; foton:ram accepts no keys. |

#### `player_storage`

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` *(required)* | `foton:file` |  |  |  |

#### `domain`

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `default` | boolean | `false` |  |  |
| `seed` | string |  |  |  |
| `default_gamemode` | [`gamemode`](#gamemode) | `"survival"` |  |  |
| `difficulty` | [`difficulty`](#difficulty) | `"normal"` |  |  |
| `storage` | [`storage`](#storage) |  |  |  |
| `worlds` *(required)* | array of [`world`](#world) |  | ≥ 1 item(s) |  |

#### `world`

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` *(required)* | [`world_name`](#world-name) |  |  |  |
| `generator` *(required)* | [`identifier`](#identifier) |  |  |  |
| `default` | boolean | `false` |  |  |
| `seed` | string |  |  |  |
| `default_gamemode` | [`gamemode`](#gamemode) | `"survival"` |  |  |
| `difficulty` | [`difficulty`](#difficulty) | `"normal"` |  |  |
| `storage` | [`storage`](#storage) |  |  |  |
| `nether_portal_target` | [`world_name`](#world-name) |  |  |  |
| `end_portal_target` | [`world_name`](#world-name) |  |  |  |
| `config` | table |  |  | Generator-specific config validated by the selected generator |

### Value types used by `worlds.toml`

| Name | Accepts | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="identifier"></a>`identifier` | string matching `^[a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9_.-]+(/[a-z0-9_.-]+)*$` |  |
| <a id="world-name"></a>`world_name` | string matching `^[a-z0-9_.-]+$` |  |
| <a id="gamemode"></a>`gamemode` | `survival` \| `creative` \| `adventure` \| `spectator` |  |
| <a id="difficulty"></a>`difficulty` | `peaceful` \| `easy` \| `normal` \| `hard` |  |

## `groups.toml` — Permissions

Permission group configuration schema for Foton.

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `default_groups` *(required)* | array of [`group_name`](#group-name) | `["default"]` | unique | Groups applied to every player |
| `groups` *(required)* | table |  |  | Permission groups keyed by group name |

### Shapes used by `groups.toml`

#### `group`

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `priority` | integer | `0` |  | Conflict priority for equally specific group rules. Higher wins. |
| `inherits` | array of [`group_name`](#group-name) | `[]` | unique | Parent groups inherited by this group |
| `allow` | array of [`permission_rule_expression`](#permission-rule-expression) | `[]` | unique | Permission expressions explicitly allowed by this group |
| `deny` | array of [`permission_rule_expression`](#permission-rule-expression) | `[]` | unique | Permission expressions explicitly denied by this group |
| `metadata` | array of [`metadata_rule`](#metadata-rule) | `[]` |  | Ordered typed metadata rules |

#### `metadata_rule`

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` *(required)* | [`permission_metadata_expression`](#permission-metadata-expression) |  |  | Namespaced metadata key with an optional context selector, such as plugin:max_homes{domain=survival}. |
| `value` *(required)* | [`permission_metadata_value`](#permission-metadata-value) |  |  | Typed permission metadata value |

### Value types used by `groups.toml`

| Name | Accepts | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="group-name"></a>`group_name` | string matching `^[a-z0-9_-]+$` |  |
| <a id="permission-rule-expression"></a>`permission_rule_expression` | string matching `^(\*|[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*(\.\*)?)(\{([a-z0-9_-]+|[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*:[a-z0-9_-]+([./][a-z0-9_-]+)*)=[^\s{},=]+(,([a-z0-9_-]+|[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*:[a-z0-9_-]+([./][a-z0-9_-]+)*)=[^\s{},=]+)*\})?$` | Permission key with an optional context selector, such as foton.fly{domain=lobby}. |
| <a id="permission-metadata-expression"></a>`permission_metadata_expression` | string matching `^[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*:[a-z0-9_-]+([./][a-z0-9_-]+)*(\{([a-z0-9_-]+|[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*:[a-z0-9_-]+([./][a-z0-9_-]+)*)=[^\s{},=]+(,([a-z0-9_-]+|[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*:[a-z0-9_-]+([./][a-z0-9_-]+)*)=[^\s{},=]+)*\})?$` | Namespaced metadata key with an optional context selector, such as plugin:max_homes{domain=survival}. |
| <a id="permission-metadata-value"></a>`permission_metadata_value` | boolean or integer or string | Typed permission metadata value |
